# GitHub Issue Templates

This directory contains templates for common issue types to help with project management.

## Issue Types

- **Bug Report** - Report a bug or unexpected behavior
- **Feature Request** - Suggest a new feature or enhancement
- **Documentation** - Improvements or corrections to documentation

## Important Note

This project is **ARCHIVED** and maintained for portfolio purposes only.  
Issues and feature requests are not actively addressed.

For reference or learning purposes, feel free to fork the repository.
